title: Brutal Drinks Mango Lassi 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Brutal Drinks’ Mango Lassi Shortfill e-liquid captures the indulgent taste of the classic Indian drink with its rich blend of ripe Mango, smooth, tangy Yoghurt and the gentle spice of Cardamom. This luxurious flavour delivers a sweet and creamy vaping experience that fans of exotic drink-inspired blends will love. Brutal Drinks Shortfills are expertly crafted by Just Juice to deliver bold flavours in a high-VG formula. Designed for sub-ohm devices and advanced kits, these shortfills produce dense clouds and rich flavour. Each 100ml bottle leaves space for two nicotine shots, giving vapers the flexibility to customise their nicotine strength. Part of the Brutal Drinks collection, Mango Lassi joins a range of bold, drink-inspired flavours, including Pina Colada, Frozen Mojito, and Blackcurrant Crush. Explore the full collection for more refreshing blends.
